name: lem-hx-transverse-moment-identity
source: imports validated registry lemma proofs/lem-hx-transverse-moment-identity — For every finite exact signed idempotent P, all points q0 != q1 of the row polytope K(P) = conv{p_i}, and every affine function chi on R^I with chi(q0) = 0 and chi(q1) = 1, the full row-point fibers satisfy sum_Q d_Q*chi(p_Q) = 1, where d_Q = sum_{j in Q}(q1_j - q0_j).
